name: vulnerableapp-scanner-benchmark
title: VulnerableApp scanner benchmark
description: How well security scanners detect the vulnerabilities in OWASP VulnerableApp. Built by the AnalyticalEngine from VulnerableApp's scanner benchmark results. The schema is independent of the engine and of any visualization: anything that reads CSV can consume it.

resources.name: runs
resources.description: One row per benchmark per run date. Rows accumulate, so this is the history.

fields.name: run_date
fields.description: Date of the run that produced this row (UTC, set by --run-date).

fields.name: benchmark
fields.description: Benchmark id from the sources file, e.g. zap-modern. Joins runs to findings.

fields.name: variant
fields.description: What distinguishes this benchmark from others of the same scanner, e.g. Modern UI or a ruleset.

fields.name: scanner_version
fields.description: Scanner version, when the results file records it.

fields.name: missed
fields.description: Expected vulnerabilities the scanner did not find.

fields.name: unmatched
fields.description: Reported items that match no expected vulnerability. Not necessarily false positives.

fields.name: coverage
fields.description: detected / total_expected * 100, two decimals; 0 when total_expected is 0.

resources.name: findings
resources.description: Every item of each benchmark's latest result, mapped to a VulnerableApp challenge. Rewritten on each run.

fields.name: status
fields.description: detected and missed rows are expected vulnerabilities; unmatched rows are reported items that match none.

fields.name: challenge
fields.description: VulnerableApp challenge, e.g. JWTVulnerability. Empty when the item is not on a challenge.

fields.name: level
fields.description: Challenge level, e.g. LEVEL_3. DAST only.

fields.name: vulnerability_type
fields.description: Type as named by the ground truth or the scanner.

fields.name: cwe
fields.description: CWE id, e.g. CWE-89. The common key across scanners.
